summary: VPN disconnects every few minutes on home Wi-Fi
resolution: Switched the VPN client to the TCP profile and updated it to version 6.2. Fixed.

summary: Shared calendar does not show the product team's meetings
resolution: Re-added the shared calendar with read permission. The team's meetings show again.

summary: Laptop battery drains in two hours
resolution: Battery replaced under warranty. Laptop swapped for a loaner for one day.

summary: Webcam not detected in video calls after the OS update
resolution: Rolled back the camera driver and paused the update on that laptop until the vendor fix ships.

summary: Cannot open the Finance portal after password change
resolution: Cleared the cached single sign-on token and re-enrolled multi-factor authentication.

summary: Notebook server runs out of memory on large datasets
resolution: Raised the memory limit to 16 GB. The reporter says jobs still crash on datasets over 10 GB.
Renewed the seat and re-activated it on the laptop.
Replaced the USB-C dock with the approved model from the IT catalogue.

summary: Code editor freezes when opening the main repository
resolution: Excluded build folders from file watching. The reporter says it still freezes when switching branches.

summary: Test phones cannot join the office guest network
Clicked a link in a phishing email
resolution: Password reset and sessions revoked. Reported to the security team. No data accessed.

summary: Cannot publish to the documentation site: permission denied
resolution: Added her to the docs-publishers group.

summary: Build server takes 40 minutes per build
resolution: Added two build agents. The reporter says builds still take over 30 minutes.
